combat_progression.rationale: The source implements firing, enemy spawning, projectile collisions, scoring, lives, score-based difficulty escalation, natural game-over, and restart. One point is withheld because retained evaluator evidence does not show a projectile hit or natural lives-to-zero transition.
evidence: public/game.js:12-18 contains enemy movement/spawning, projectile collision scoring, lives decrement, game-over, and the animation loop.
public/logic.js:2,4 and results/evidence/monolith_sol_low_fast_opencode/test.log show passing collision and difficulty tests.
automated.json records projectileCount 1, enemyCount 4, and an adapter-driven gameover state.

visual_design.rationale: The screenshots show a cohesive neon arcade art direction, strong hierarchy, responsive layout, HUD, leaderboard, grid, glowing ship, and sound-state feedback. One point is withheld because the retained playing screenshot shows no active enemy, projectile, or hit-feedback moment.
evidence: desktop-before.png visibly shows the cyan/pink neon title, HUD, start overlay, game grid, leaderboard panel, and quote treatment.
desktop-after.png visibly shows the playing grid, glowing player ship, score/hull HUD, leaderboard, and SOUND: OFF state.
mobile.png visibly shows a clipped-free stacked layout with touch left/right/FIRE controls and the leaderboard.
public/game.js:13,17 implements particle bursts, glow/shadow effects, moving grid lines, and neon entities.

resilience_accessibility.rationale: Loading, empty, offline, validation, and submission-failure states are implemented, with labels and status feedback; the browser evidence reports no runtime errors.
evidence: public/game.js:19,21 contains loading/empty/network-offline handling and validation/transmission status messages.
public/index.html:2-4 provides aria-labels, a callsign label, and role=status feedback.
automated.json reports 5 labeled elements and zero console/page errors.

data_security.rationale: The checked-in migration provides RLS, constrained input validation, least-privilege anonymous policies/grants, and denied anonymous updates/deletes. Browser source exposes only a publishable Supabase key, and the evaluator recorded real remote reads and inserts.
evidence: supabase/migrations/001_leaderboard.sql:1-8 defines NOT NULL fields, 1-16 character trimmed callsigns, an allowlisted regex, and a bounded integer score.
supabase/migrations/001_leaderboard.sql:11-23 enables RLS, grants anon select/insert and sequence access, and revokes anon update/delete.
public/game.js:2-6 contains an sb_publishable key and no service-role or privileged browser credential.
browser-evaluator.log and automated.json record Supabase GET 200, POST 201, and subsequent GET 200 requests.

engineering_quality.rationale: The project has a pinned lockfile, useful pure-logic extraction, passing automated tests, and explicit check/deploy scripts. Two points are withheld for heavily compressed source and narrow helper-only test coverage; no separate build/check log is retained.
evidence: results/evidence/monolith_sol_low_fast_opencode/test.log records 4 passing tests and 0 failures.
package.json defines test, check, and deploy scripts; package-lock.json uses lockfileVersion 3 and pins wrangler 4.120.0.
public/logic.js separates reusable gameplay helpers from public/game.js.
public/game.js, public/index.html, public/styles.css, and test/logic.test.js are largely compressed into one-line/minimal-format files.

reproducibility.rationale: The handoff is reproducible beyond the result artifact: README instructions, migration SQL, source manifest, lockfile, test commands, controls, security decisions, and deployment steps are all present and consistent with evaluator evidence.
evidence: README.md:5-26 documents local setup, controls, architecture, security, migration reproduction, and deployment.
supabase/migrations/001_leaderboard.sql and source-manifest.txt preserve the database and application artifacts; package-lock.json preserves dependency resolution.
automated.json validates the result artifact, while browser-evaluator.log confirms HTTP 200 and the remote leaderboard round trip.

summary: Manual evidence review awarded 42 of the remaining 46 points; the deterministic evaluator evidence accounts for the other 54.
